metric_names.FsF-F1-01MD: Metadata and data are assigned a globally unique identifier.
metric_names.FsF-F1-02MD: Metadata and data are assigned a persistent identifier.
metric_names.FsF-F2-01M: Metadata includes descriptive core elements (creator, title, data identifier, publisher, publication date, summary and keywords) to support data findability.
metric_names.FsF-F3-01M: Metadata includes the identifier of the data it describes.
metric_names.FsF-F4-01M: Metadata is offered in such a way that it can be registered or indexed by search engines.
metric_names.FsF-A1-01M: Metadata contains access level and access conditions of the data.
metric_names.FsF-A1-02MD: Metadata and data are retrievable by their identifier
metric_names.FsF-A1.1-01MD: A standardized communication protocol is used to access metadata and data.
metric_names.FsF-A1.2-01MD: Metadata and data are accessible through a standardized communication protocol which supports authentication.
metric_names.FsF-I1-01M: Metadata is represented using a formal knowledge representation language.
metric_names.FsF-I3-01M: Metadata includes qualified references between the data and its related entities.
metric_names.FsF-R1-01M: Metadata specifies the content of the data.
metric_names.FsF-R1.1-01M: Metadata includes license information under which data can be reused.
metric_names.FsF-R1.2-01M: Metadata includes provenance information about data creation or generation.
metric_names.FsF-R1.3-01M: Metadata follows a standard recommended by the target research community of the data.
metric_names.FsF-R1.3-02D: Data is available in a file format recommended by the target research community.
